facts.fact: StackAdapt research found that 66% of marketers say up to 30% of programmatic budget is wasted due to siloed or fragmented execution.
facts.quote: 66% of marketers say up to 30% of programmatic budget is wasted due to siloed or fragmented execution.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt research, 53% of top-performing teams say consolidated tools drive stronger ROI, compared with 31% of other teams.
facts.quote: 53% of top-performing teams say consolidated tools drive stronger ROI, compared to just 31% of others.

facts.fact: StackAdapt platform data shows that multi-channel campaigns deliver 47% higher click-through rates than single-channel execution.
facts.quote: multi-channel campaigns deliver 47% higher click-through rates than single-channel execution.

facts.fact: The article defines marketing automation as AI-driven orchestration across paid media and adjacent owned touchpoints, such as programmatic advertising coordinated with triggered email or on-site experiences.
facts.quote: marketing automation refers to AI-driven orchestration across paid media and adjacent owned touchpoints,

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's own research, top-performing organizations are far more likely to reduce the number of tools in their marketing stack by 25–50%.
